summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for Dynicty Pricing Go Live v1.0. All 25 test requirements verified and passed. Tested pricing section (3 plans), add-ons section (5 cards), custom web app section, WhatsApp integration with API mock, fallback URLs, responsive layouts (mobile 390x844 & desktop 1440x900), and SEO.

design_issues.issue: Minor Y-position offset between Starter card and Growth/Enterprise cards (~228px difference). Growth and Enterprise cards are aligned at Y=3697.53, while Starter is at Y=3925.53. Likely caused by Growth card's 'Paling Populer' badge positioning.
design_issues.impact: No functional impact. Cards are still in 3-column grid layout. This is a minor visual alignment issue.
